name: Espresso - a stronger coffee
author: Anders
description: Adds an Espresso drink, brewed at the Coffee Maker from 6 Coffee Beans. It gives a stronger movement speed boost than a Cup of Coffee (walk 4.85, run 5.3, bike 5.8) for 24 hours. The item reuses a blank item slot and the game's own Coffee state, so removing the mod leaves nothing broken behind. Edit the CONFIG block in js/plugins/Espresso.js.
